changelog:
- Initial release of the "learn-prototype" skill, promoting the 改良主义 (improvement-first) learning method.
- Guides users to start with a minimal, "runnable" prototype instead of waiting for perfect preparation.
- Emphasizes user-driven problem discovery and hypothesis-driven iteration for improvement.
- Requires all improvements and insights to be derived from user-confirmed prior knowledge.
- Encourages users to document their own improvement methods as transferable principles.
- Provides clear workflow and principles, including connections to related skills like `learn-graph` and `learn-feynman`.
summary: 当用户要做/研究一个东西、想提升某个技能、或觉得某个产出不够好想改进时使用。用「改良主义」先逼出一个最垃圾但能跑的原型，再引导他自己洞察缺陷、提出问题，提改良假说→实践检验→迭代，信奉「洞察缺陷 > 如何优化 > 最终答案」，并把每次改进的方法本身沉淀成方法论。触发场景：要做 X、研究 X、提升 X、X 做得不好...
